text:
Nina: Heads up — release cut blocked, deploy-bot failing to promote canary to prod.
Nina: CI artifact restore failing with symlink permission errors on multiple runners.
Carlos: Failing excerpt:
```
+ tar -xzf release.tgz
tar: lib/tool -> ../tool: Cannot create symlink
ERROR: unpack failed
```
ops-jen: Oncall. Kernel auto-update landed on cache hosts this morning; I see similar failures. Reverting during change window is risky (~20m).
ops-jen: Recommend manual pin to last-good SHA to avoid missing the change window.
Nina: If we manual promote, need audit trail and release-note entry. Who can run it?
Carlos: I can run manual promote. Command I'll use:
```
/deploy promote --image sha:7b9d33 --env prod --reason "pin-due-to-cache-untar-symlink-fail"
```
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt blocked: lease_acquire_timeout on artifact-indexer (retries exhausted).
Carlos: Running manual promote now. /deploy promote --image sha:7b9d33 --env prod --reason "pin-due-to-cache-untar-symlink-fail"
deploy-bot: Manual promote initiated by Carlos. Rollout -> health checks pass -> promotion complete. prod image sha:7b9d33.
qa-bot: Queued quick smoke (uploads, auth); reporting in ~10m.
ops-jen: Creating infra ticket INFRA-2101 with logs and failing job ids bk/5581,bk/5584. Follow-up scheduled off-window.
Nina: Release notes draft: "Pinned to sha:7b9d33 due to CI artifact extraction (symlink permission) failures after cache host kernel update; infra ticket INFRA-2101."
Carlos: I'll add the exact promote command to the docs and include reasoning.
Nina: Closing thread for cut; follow-ups tracked. Thank you everyone.
